questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: The compound formed as a result of oxidation of ethyl benzene by KMnO<sub>4 </sub> is :

options.content: benzophenone
acetophenone
benzoic acid
benzyl alcohol

questions.explanation: When alkyl benzene are oxidised with alkaline (strong oxidising agent) the entire alkyl group is oxidised to group regardless of length of side chain.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Presence of a nitro group in a benzene ring

options.content: activates the ring towards electrophilic substitution
renders the ring basic
deactivates the ring towards nucleophilic substitution
deactivates the ring towards electrophilic substitution

questions.explanation: Nitro group is electron withdrawing group, so it deactivities the ring towards electrophilic substitution.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Which one of the following conformation of cyclohexane is chiral?

options.content: Twist boat
Rigid
Chair
Boat

questions.explanation: Chiral conformation will not have plane of symmetry. Since twist boat does not have plane of symmetry it is chiral.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content: Identify the correct statement regarding a spontaneous process :

options.content: For a spontaneous process in an isolated system, the change in entropy is positive
Endothermic processes are never spontaneous
Exothermic processes are always spontaneous
Lowering of energy in the reaction process is the only criterion for spontaneity

questions.explanation: Spontaneity of reaction depends on tendency to acquire minimum energy state and maximum randomness. For a spontaneous process in an isolated system the change in entropy is positive.

questions.subject: chemistry
questions.content:
The actinoids exhibits more number of oxidation states in general than the lanthanoids. This is
because :

options.content: the 5f orbitals are more buried than the 4f orbitals
there is a similarity between 4f and 5f orbitals in their angular part of the wave function
the actinoids are more reactive than the lanthanoids
the 5f orbitals extend further from the nucleus than the 4f orbitals

questions.explanation: NOTE : More the distance between nucleus and outer orbitals, lesser will be force of attraction on them. Distance between nucleus and orbitals is more as compared to distance between orbital and nucleus. So actinoids exhibit more number of oxidation states in general than the lanthanoids.

Among aliphatic amines the order of basicity is The electron density is decreased in amine due to crowing of alkyl group over atom which makes the approach and bonding by a proton relatively difficult. dimethylamine ( aliphatic amine) is strongest base among gtiven choices.

questions.content: Which of the following hydrogen bonds is the strongest?

options.content: O−H…….N
F−H…….F
O−H…….O
O−H…….F

questions.explanation:
Among F, O and N, F is most electronegative so F pulls bond pair of electron in F - H towards itself and develops highly positive charge on H atom.

This highly positive charged H atom creates stongest hydrogen bonding by taking lone pair of electron form electronegative atom F/N/O. Hence among the given options F – H ...... F is the strongest bond.

Note : F – H ...... N has strongest hydogen bonding among F – H ...... F, F – H ...... O and F – H ...... N because N is least electronegative among F, O and N and can easily donate lone pair of electron.

From avogadro hypothesis we know at STP 1 mole of any as occupies 22.4 L.

moles of H2(g) occupies = = 11.2 L

Option B :

According to avogadro Hypothesis, volume is directly proportional to the no of moles of gases.
Only for gases, no of mole and volume relationship is possible i.e, for two gases if no of moles are same then their volume is also same. But here HCL is in aqueous form and H2 is in gaseous form so we can't find volume of HCL(aq) using no of moles of HCL(aq).

questions.explanation:
NOTE : When a charged particle enters a magnetic field at a direction perpendicular to the direction of motion, the path of the motion is circular. In circular motion the direction of velocity changes at every point (the magnitude remains constant).

Therefore, the tangential momentum will change at every point. But kinetic energy will remain constant as it is given by and is the square of the magnitude of velocity which does not change.

questions.explanation:
First, let's consider the capacitor with the dielectric between its plates. The charge on the capacitor is Q, its capacitance is C (which includes the effect of the dielectric), and the potential difference (voltage) across its plates is V. According to the formula for the energy stored in a capacitor :

we find that the energy is equal to half of the product of the capacitance and the square of the voltage.

Now, consider the process where the dielectric slab is removed from the capacitor. When the dielectric is removed, the capacitance of the capacitor decreases. However, because the capacitor is not connected to anything that can supply or absorb charge, the charge Q on the capacitor stays the same. Since the charge stays the same but the capacitance decreases, the voltage V across the capacitor must increase to keep Q = CV true.

The energy of the capacitor without the dielectric is still given by :

but now C is smaller and V is larger. However, because both C and V2 change in such a way that their product remains constant, the energy of the capacitor doesn't change when the dielectric is removed.

Therefore, the energy of the capacitor before the dielectric is removed is the same as the energy of the capacitor after the dielectric is removed. When the dielectric is reinserted, the process is just reversed, so again no net work is done.

So the total work done by the system in the process of removing the dielectric and then reinserting it is zero. This is because work is the transfer of energy, and in this case, the energy of the system (the charged capacitor) does not change. Therefore, no energy is transferred, so no work is done.
